name: yq6h24-aqua-claude
goal: Preserve MB2's active sessions while new Claude launches use the Aqua keychain, refuse a signed-out pane, and prove a launcher-started Haiku reply

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: MB2 Aqua direct and Aqua-owned tmux report subscription, while the existing SSH-owned claude server reports signed out. Keep legacy panes and route new MB2 Claude launches through a separate Aqua socket.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing managed-worker and foreground scenarios cover signed-out preflight and first-run onboarding. Their tmux fixture does not distinguish sockets, and no screen fixture represents successful preflight followed by the locked-keychain pane. Extend the same worker roundtrip and foreground rejection assertions for both gaps.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
